# tone event pitch value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:toneEventPitchValue`](gmeow-toneEventPitchValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/toneEventPitchValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A frame-relative pitch value sounded by this [`ToneEvent`](../classes/gmeow-ToneEvent.md). Mutually exclusive with [`toneEventPitchTrajectory`](gmeow-toneEventPitchTrajectory.md) and [`toneEventIsUnpitched`](gmeow-toneEventIsUnpitched.md); SHACL enforces at most one pitch-content mode.
